label: DIAGNOSTIC SCREEN. Kill-only asymmetric screen (Opus review 2026-10-15). Improvement earns a future-filter pre-registration slot only -- never a weight, never a promotion. Emission ZERO_OBJECT. passed stays false.
spec_source: Oct 14 Architectural Deepening doc (Drive), formulas recovered from OMML equations; doc kernels in wf_situational_engine.py
filter: REG 2017 W1 - 2026 W5, non-null scores and spread_line

screen_protocol.rule: delta_full < 0 on the operative reference -> SCREENED-SURVIVED (pre-registration slot on the FUTURE filter); delta_full >= 0 -> SCREENED-KILLED (refused, recorded)
screen_protocol.operative_reference: family-2 construction (7.133199) where composable; else baseline with explicit flag
screen_protocol.beta_fit: expanding window by (season, week) blocks; doc grid [-0.25, 0.50] x151 for baseline screens; 31-point grid (step 0.025) for family-2-composed fits (documented); >=25 prior defined games else beta=0
screen_protocol.multiplicity_note: 7 pathway looks (CAOFI; RIL_sum; RIL_|dRIL|; OLCAI; SPESE scale; SPESE atom; QPTSR) on the operative reference, each also read vs baseline and under the branch harness (non-operative readings); SAI combination adds 1 look when screened. BQP and SWCC contribute 0 frozen looks (PARKED / REFUSED-prior).

CAOFI.target_parameter: sigma scale: sigma_adj = sigma_base * (1 + beta * CAOFI)

RIL-P1.target_parameter: sigma scale: sigma_adj = sigma_base * (1 + beta_sum * RIL_sum + beta_diff * |dRIL|)

OLCAI.target_parameter: sigma scale: sigma_adj = sigma_base * exp(beta * OLCAI)

SPESE.target_parameter: sigma scale: sigma_adj = sigma_base * (1 + beta * (SPESE - SPESE_bar)); AND atom weight on P(|M|=7) vs P(|M|=3) with p_37 preserved

SPESE_atom.note: atom pathway exists only composed on a key-number base (family-2); no baseline form

QPTSR.target_parameter: sigma scale: sigma_adj = sigma_base * (1 + beta * QPTSR)

BQP.target_parameter: sigma scale: sigma_adj = sigma_base * (1 + beta * max(0, BQP))

spese_survival_robustness.check: fixed-beta=0.5 family-2-conditional scale screen (no weekly refit), per-season paired deltas on the 2,412 defined games
spese_survival_robustness.finding: Effect is small and season-unstable (5 of 10 seasons positive). SPESE survives the screen AS DEFINED and earns a future-filter pre-registration slot ONLY. beta_last sits at the doc grid edge (0.50) on both the baseline and family-2 scale fits and gamma at the edge on the atom fit -- the fitted modulation wants more than the grid allows; treat the magnitude as unreliable.

audit_notes.olcai_redundancy: OLCAI improves vs the Gaussian baseline (-0.004962 full-filter, the largest baseline delta of any screened metric) but degrades conditional on family-2 (+0.002418) and under the branch harness (+0.001663). Killed as redundant: its sigma information is already carried by family-2's total-line hetero sigma. This is the Opus review's redundancy case.

coverage_mechanisms.CAOFI_1701_of_2462: stadiums.json (landed with schedule_meta) carries null lat/lon/timezone/altitude for ambiguous-Wikidata venues (e.g. CHI98 Soldier Field): 410 filter games at null-geo venues, 739 games missing at least one tz component -> fail-closed per spec.
coverage_mechanisms.SWCC_1639_of_2462: travel miles unavailable for 662 games (same null-geo stadiums gap, venue or away-origin side) + 161 Week-1 games with no prior in-season game.
coverage_mechanisms.RIL-P1_600_of_2462: 351 games in unstamped injury seasons (2025 + 2026 W1-5: no date_modified column in the current nflverse injuries release) + 1,511 team-game kernel failures: the doc kernel/prose fail a team closed when ANY player on its stamped report lacks a computable prior-3-week snap share (long-term-out and zero-snap reported players poison the whole team-week).
coverage_mechanisms.QPTSR_982_of_2462: the doc's starter rule (prior game's >60% dropback passer) fails on 3,798 of 4,924 team-games -- any QB-rotated prior game (injury/benching/blowout) makes the NEXT game fail-closed for that side.
